jobs.title: Placement Supervisor (Nursing and Midwifery)
jobs.reason: This is a placement administration role in nursing/midwifery education — operational and regulatory compliance work in a clinical training context, far from the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence focus. It also requires experience leading an administrative team and familiarity with NMC and PSRB regulatory frameworks, which the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor Food
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a food industry auditing role requiring a food technology degree, 5+ years in food production, third-party auditing qualifications (IFS/BRC), and fluent Dutch. Hard ineligibility on multiple grounds: required Dutch fluency (candidate has only A1), 5+ years hard experience requirement, and specialist food-industry credentials the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Lecturer / Associate Lecturer (Computer Science / Data Science)
jobs.reason: Academic computer science lectureship requiring a PhD (Lecturer) or Master's in CS plus active PhD registration (Associate Lecturer) — the candidate holds neither, triggering hard ineligibility on seniority. Field (computer science teaching/research) and required CS specialisation are also a mismatch with the candidate's IR background.
